# OlympiaDAO — On-Chain Governance for Ethereum Classic

## About

OlympiaDAO is on-chain governance and treasury infrastructure for Ethereum Classic (ETC). Transaction fee revenue (EIP-1559 basefee) funds the protocol vault — block rewards remain completely untouched.

## Governance Process

Five stages from proposal to execution — every step on-chain, transparent, and auditable:

1. Propose — Any member submits a governance proposal on-chain
2. Vote — Members cast on-chain votes during a defined voting period
3. Queue — Approved proposals enter a security timelock
4. Execute — After timelock expires, the proposal executes automatically
5. Disclose — All outcomes publicly reported and independently verifiable

## Treasury Funding

Three-step funding flow:
1. Transaction Fees — Every transaction pays a basefee, directed to the Treasury
2. Treasury — Protocol-managed vault accumulates transaction fee revenue, donations, and mining rewards
3. Governance — Community proposals allocate treasury funds through on-chain voting

## Deployed Contracts (Demo v0.3)

Nine contracts deployed via deterministic CREATE2 (salt: OLYMPIA_DEMO_V0_3) — identical addresses on Mordor Testnet (63) and ETC Mainnet (61). See lib/contracts.json for full address list.

## Network

- Mordor Testnet: Chain ID 63
- ETC Mainnet: Chain ID 61
- Next Step: Mordor Testnet Deployment
